name: Thaumaturgical Rituals (Sabbat) — 1 Basic — Dominoe of Life

system.description: Carrying a small vial of mortal blood (at least a quarter Blood Trait), this ritual lets you assume one physical characteristic of mortality per casting (body temperature, appetite for solid food, respiration/pulse, or flesh tone). Effects may be stacked by casting multiple times and last until an hour after dawn.
